taskAnchor.targetDefect: N314 receives trusted sequence state and trusted current time as ordinary caller parameters, so restart can reset and rewind the freshness root
taskAnchor.userLastConstraint: Old artifacts or validation results cannot be presented as current work; no silent fallback; Producer and Verifier remain separate.

trigger: After verifier restart, the presenter supplies a reset sequence state and rewound current time, then replays the complete old dispatch anchor and its old authorized attestation.
expected: Loss or rollback of the freshness root must fail closed; the verifier must use an independently pinned, authenticated, monotonic checkpoint rather than caller inputs.
observed: N314 returned DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE_VERIFIED for the entire old bundle when state was reset to sequence zero and now was rewound into the old attestation window.
rootCause: N314 describes trusted time and persisted sequence state as boundaries but its executable function does not authenticate their provenance or persistence.
minimumVerification: reset state plus rewound time can reproduce the vulnerable N314 pass
older still-valid checkpoint is rejected against the independently pinned sequence
same-sequence checkpoint with wrong previous digest is rejected
old dispatch bundle is rejected against the current checkpoint
fresh dispatch and attestation pass against the current checkpoint

stateSemantics.HOLD_FRESHNESS_ROOT_MISSING: An initialized scope has no independently persisted checkpoint; absence is not genesis.
stateSemantics.HOLD_PRODUCER_FRESHNESS_ROOT: Producer cannot sign or choose the freshness root used to validate its own evidence.
stateSemantics.HOLD_FRESHNESS_CHECKPOINT_ROLLBACK: Presented checkpoint sequence is older than the independent pin.
stateSemantics.HOLD_FRESHNESS_CHECKPOINT_LINEAGE_MISMAT: Checkpoint does not extend the pinned predecessor.
stateSemantics.HOLD_VERIFIER_DISPATCH_SEQUENCE_ROLLBACK: Replayed dispatch is not newer than the authenticated checkpoint state.
stateSemantics.DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE_VERIFIED: Current authorized attestation is evaluated against an authenticated checkpoint and its fixed trusted time.

teacherDecision.name: The Update Framework rollback and freeze protections
teacherDecision.reason: N314 already captured persisted trusted versions and fixed trusted time. N315 adds no external method; it proves KAOPU failed to transfer that known requirement into the executable prototype.

deduplication.TASK_FRESHNESS_AND_NO_STALE_DELIVERY_GAT: Defines post-dispatch freshness but not an authenticated restart-safe freshness root.
deduplication.TERRAIN_NO_STALE_DELIVERY_001: Covers stale artifacts; N315 covers stale verifier state accepted after root reset.
deduplication.N314: Rejects stale signed evidence only while its caller-provided state and clock remain honest. N315 tests loss or rollback of that assumption.

boundaries: The replay uses deterministic fixture keys, times, dispatches, and checkpoint state.
The pinned root is a prototype constant, not a real durable store or transparency service.
The prototype does not prove checkpoint availability, non-equivocation, crash recovery, trusted hardware, or key rotation.
No production Mother, main, R2 OS, adapter registry, or public KaoPuGram service changes.
Candidate remains inactive until an affected Mother acknowledges and a live bounded route proves independent persistence.
